per_gene_auc_definition: ROC AUC of the gene's validation logCPM, with higher expression scored as predicting LV; directions are not flipped to maximize AUC.
composite_definition: Equal-weight mean of within-cohort z-scores for the same eight genes detected in both cohorts; no classifier was fitted. Standardization did not use phenotype labels.
ci_method: Stratified percentile bootstrap, 5000 resamples per score; seed 42.
limitations: Small validation sample sizes make AUC estimates imprecise.
These are exploratory score evaluations, not fitted logistic-regression performance estimates.
Panel discovery used GSE125498; these plots use additional effluent cohorts.
Independence of GSE248762 and GSE130888 patient samples is not formally established.
The shared eight-gene composite omits TNFSF15, which was not detected in GSE130888.
